reason: a C-variadic function of the public ABI cannot be defined in stable Rust (the `c_variadic` feature is unstable), so only the argument marshalling is written in C and every behavioural decision is made by the Rust functions it calls back into

the platform's struct layout is the platform's business -- the field offsets of `struct dirent`, `struct stat` and `ucontext_t` are read on the C side of the ABI so that no field offset or alignment is assumed in Rust
